authorActualScienceObservations: Column headers explicitly name Ethanal and Propanon; bottom qualifier visibly says Nur diese Beispiele.
Tollens positive panel shows metallic silver coating on tube wall; right panel transparent/no coating.
Fehling left shows brick-red bottom Cu2O solid separated from pale liquid; right shows homogeneous blue liquid without precipitate.
No universal aldehyde/ketone group claim remains. These are expected schematic outcomes for suitable test conditions, not empirical learner/teacher performance.

limits: Cu2O-Niederschlag and Kein Silberspiegel are relatively compact at 360px; main silver/solid/blue differences remain visible. Independent V mobile acceptance is pending.
